# Visual Timer for Kids

> Visual Timer for Kids is a free iOS countdown timer app for children made by Natalia Jakubczyk-Gajewska. As the timer runs, a picture is slowly revealed, so kids who can't read a clock can see how much time is left. It is used by parents and teachers for daily routines — homework, screen time limits, tooth brushing, morning and bedtime routines — and is especially helpful for toddlers and for children with ADHD or autism.

Website: https://kidstimer.app
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1537955071?pt=118868513&ct=webnew&mt=8

## Key facts

- Rating: 4.6 / 5 stars from 1,400+ App Store ratings
- Price: free to download; optional premium via in-app purchase; Family Sharing supported
- Platforms: iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Macs; age rating 4+
- Languages: 22, including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Arabic, and Chinese
- Content: 200 pictures, 25 backgrounds, 20 music themes, 10 time's-up sounds; parents can add their own photos
- The timer works in the background and sends a notification when time is up
- Category: Education; first released 2020
